description: This file provides declarations and macros for managing MKL-DNN (oneDNN) integration within ATen, the tensor library used in PyTorch. It includes functions for data type conversions, tensor creation from data pointers, tensor views, and version checks related to MKL-DNN.

methods.name: dnnl::memory::data_type get_mkldnn_dtype(const Tensor & t)
methods.description: Converts a ScalarType to its corresponding oneDNN data type.

methods.name: data_ptr_from_mkldnn
methods.description: Retrieves the data pointer from an MKL-DNN tensor.

methods.name: mkldnn_tensor_from_data_ptr
methods.description: Creates an MKL-DNN tensor from a raw data pointer, dimensions, data type, and device.

methods.name: new_with_itensor_mkldnn
methods.description: Constructs an ATen tensor from an ideep tensor with optional data type and device.

methods.name: itensor_from_mkldnn
methods.description: Extracts an ideep tensor reference from an MKL-DNN tensor.

methods.name: nbytes_from_mkldnn
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes occupied by an MKL-DNN tensor.

methods.name: itensor_view_from_dense
methods.description: Creates a shared-buffer ideep tensor view from a dense tensor.

methods.name: itensor_view_from_dense
methods.description: Creates a shared-buffer ideep tensor view using a tensor descriptor.

methods.name: itensor_from_tensor
methods.description: Helper to get an ideep tensor out of an ATen tensor or MKL-DNN tensor.

methods.name: set_verbose
methods.description: Sets the verbose level for MKL-DNN debugging output.
